item.title: Plover (WI) FD Receives 45 New SCBA Cylinders Through Federal Grant
item.description: The Plover (WI) Fire Department upgraded safety equipment by receiving a $422,733 federal grant and a local match of $21,136. The post Plover (WI) FD Receives 45 New SCBA Cylinders Through Federal Grant appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: MA Town Says Goodbye to Historic Fire Station
item.description: Building committee members and firefighters swung sledgehammers in a ceremonial gesture, taking turns striking the interior walls of the structure that has served the department for roughly 60 years. The post MA Town Says Goodbye to Historic Fire Station appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Provincetown (MA) FD Apparatus Crashes Into Utility Pole
item.description: A Provincetown (MA) Fire Department engine crashed into a utility pole while returning from a medical emergency. No injuries were reported, and the cause is under investigation. The post Provincetown (MA) FD Apparatus Crashes Into Utility Pole appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Ford to Donate Darley-Equipped Broncos to Search and Rescue Teams
item.description: Ford is donating five Darley-equipped Bronco Badlands models to under-resourced search and rescue organizations. Applications are now open. The post Ford to Donate Darley-Equipped Broncos to Search and Rescue Teams appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Fire Apparatus of the Day: Feb. 4, 2026
item.description: The Bonavista (Newfoundland, Canada) Fire Department spec'd a Freightliner M2 106 cab and chassis by Fort Garry Fire Trucks for its pumper-tanker. It has a 1,250-gpm pump and 1,500-gallon tank. The post Fire Apparatus of the Day: Feb. 4, 2026 appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.description: The Weslaco (TX) Fire Department added a Spartan heavy rescue-pumper, making it the department's fourth fully-staffed primary pumper. item.title: Clarksburg (WV) FD Takes Delivery of First of Two New Apparatus
item.description: The Clarksburg (WV) Fire Department recently took delivery of a Sutphen 100-foot aerial platform, and anticipates receiving a new rescue truck this summer.
